The maximum kinetic energy of the emitted electrons is \(K_{\text{max}} = E - E_g\), where \(E_g = 0.7 \mathrm{~eV}\), so \(K_{\text{max}} \approx 0.578 \mathrm{~eV}\).

The de Broglie wavelength is given by \(\lambda = \frac{h}{p}\), where \(p = \sqrt{2mK}\), \(m = 9.109 \times 10^{-31} \mathrm{~kg}\) is the electron mass, and \(K\) is the kinetic energy in joules.

\]
